morning.title: 🌅 Still • Morning Clarity
morning.body: Before the world demands your attention, give yourself 60 seconds of stillness.

morning.title: 🌅 Still • A Quiet Beginning
morning.body: You don’t have to rush into the noise. Take three deep breaths and begin with peace.

morning.title: 🌅 Still • Daily Intention
morning.body: Peace is not the absence of chaos; it is stillness in the middle of it. 432 Hz awaits.

morning.title: 🌅 Still • Ground Your Mind
morning.body: Notice the quiet before the day begins. Step into your calm sanctuary.

morning.title: 🌅 Still • Mindful Arrival
morning.body: Today, choose focus over hurry. Ground your nervous system with Still.

afternoon.title: ☀️ Still • 2-Minute Reset
afternoon.body: Unclench your jaw. Drop your shoulders. Inhale for 4s, hold for 2s, exhale for 4s.

afternoon.title: ☀️ Still • Acoustic Shield
afternoon.body: Feeling overwhelmed by the room's noise? Let 1/f² Brownian sound mask the chaos.

afternoon.title: ☀️ Still • Midday Pause
afternoon.body: Step away from the screen for just 90 seconds. Your mind needs silence to recharge.

afternoon.title: ☀️ Still • Reset Your Pace
afternoon.body: When everything feels urgent, stillness is your greatest superpower.

afternoon.title: ☀️ Still • Deep Focus Block
afternoon.body: Put on your headphones. Block distractions with alpha wave soundscapes.

evening.title: 🌙 Still • Evening Sanctuary
evening.body: The day is finished. Let go of whatever you couldn’t complete. Rest well.

evening.title: 🌙 Still • Wind-Down Space
evening.body: Dim the lights. Settle into 432 Hz Solfeggio soundscapes for deep delta sleep.

evening.title: 🌙 Still • Release the Day
evening.body: You don't need to carry today's thoughts into tomorrow. Breathe and let go.

evening.title: 🌙 Still • Night Silence
evening.body: Allow your nervous system to return to baseline. A peaceful night begins with Still.

evening.title: 🌙 Still • Restorative Peace
evening.body: Set a gentle sleep timer, close your eyes, and let deep ambient tones guide you to sleep.
